title: Pixel artefacts on specific integer screen scalings
body:
### Tested versions

- 4.4.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA TITAN X (Pascal) (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4770K CPU @ 3.50GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

When scaling the game screen (integer scaling) -either clicking and dragging the DEBUG window from the edges, or by maximizing it- Sprite2Ds moving inside it show visual artefacts in the form of deformations.

Note: the issue seems to happen only when the integer screen scaling values are multiples of 2.

Video showcase:
https://youtu.be/hI1loc2sPy8?si=iirHdEOKvYjfEuMF

### **Expected functionality**
Integer screen scaling never generates visual artefacts when moving elements around the game's screen, independant of the scale.

### Steps to reproduce

- 1: Run 'TestScene.tscn'.
- 2: On the DEBUG window, select the "Keep the aspect ratio of the embedded game." option.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/775cd8cb-1821-4e36-b4a8-46c6c2ce0dbf)
- 3: Move the mouse around the game screen checking for artefacts (no artefacts should appear with the native resolution).
- 4: Clicking and holding the edges of the DEBUG window, resize it until the game's screen scales up once and move the mouse around the screen checking for artefacts again (the video attatched in the "Issue Description" section could help with understanding this step).
- 5: For further tests, repeat step 3 as many times as your monitor's resolution allows.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[bug-showcase-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19943499/bug-showcase-project.zip)
